pages.attribution: Panacea uses Qt for Python (PySide6) and Lucide icons. Lucide assets use the ISC licence and include Feather icons under the MIT licence.
pages.autoCheckHint: Check for a new stable version of Panacea at startup.
pages.collapseSidebarHint: Show only icons in the sidebar, including in wider windows.
pages.drivesUnavailable: Drive information is unavailable. Refresh to try again.
pages.drivesUnverified: Refresh to find available fixed drives.
pages.guardBlocked: Windows maintenance is blocked. Review the diagnostic details.
pages.guardUnknown: Check whether a previous operation is blocking maintenance.
pages.guidedDescription: Ten maintenance operations, starting with a verified Windows restore point.
pages.guidedRisk: Cleanup permanently deletes browser caches, temporary files and Recycle Bin contents. The network reset may interrupt connections or require a restart. You can cancel between steps.
pages.historyEmpty: History is unavailable in this build
pages.historyEmptyHint: To see results from this session, open the section where you ran an operation.
pages.license: No project-wide licence has been published yet.
pages.noEligibleDrive: No available fixed drives. Refresh to check again.
pages.previewHint: Count eligible temporary files and estimate their size before cleaning.
pages.previewUnavailable: The preview is unavailable. Select to try again.
pages.quickDescription: Clears eligible temporary files and the Recycle Bin, cleans the Windows component store, then opens Disk Cleanup for manual choices.
pages.recommendCleanup: Free up space with quick cleanup
pages.recommendCleanupHint: Your system drive is almost full. Review which files quick cleanup removes.
pages.reduceMotionHint: Limit animations even when Windows animations are enabled.
pages.savedUnknown: Saved settings could not be verified.
pages.setting.power.purpose: Use the Windows high-performance power plan.
pages.setting.spooler.purpose: Stop the service that queues print jobs.
pages.setting.wsearch.purpose: Stop the Windows Search indexing service.
pages.step.browser_clean: Permanently remove eligible caches from supported browsers.
pages.step.chkdsk: Check the system drive for file-system errors using online CHKDSK.
pages.step.component_cleanup: Use DISM to remove superseded Windows components.
pages.step.dism_check: Check for known corruption in the Windows component image.
pages.step.dns_flush: Clear domain-name lookups cached by Windows.
pages.step.drive_optimize: Let Windows optimize the system drive for its media type.
pages.step.recycle_empty: Permanently empty the entire Recycle Bin.
pages.step.restore_point: Verify a new Windows restore point before proceeding. A failed verification stops the sequence.
pages.step.sfc: Scan and repair protected Windows system files with SFC.
pages.step.temp_clean: Delete eligible temporary files. Locked and protected files are skipped.
pages.step.winsock_reset: Reset Winsock. Connections may be interrupted and Windows may require a restart.
pages.turboDescription: Apply five Windows optimizations together, or restore the original settings saved by Panacea.
pages.turboUnavailable: State unavailable. Refresh to try again.
update.highlights220: Find cleanup, startup and repair tools in the sidebar or with **Ctrl+K**. Review the effects of each operation before you confirm. The update center shows release notes and download progress.
